title: Interrogate the trail
headline: The audit log answered, and the receipt verified cryptographically

steps.label: Question over the audit trail
steps.detail: 「Why was the payout to NewVendor blocked? What would approve it?」

steps.label: Answer from the trail (records + mandate)
steps.detail: Record #11: the payout of $800 to newvendor@unverified.test was BLOCKED — Blocked: newvendor@unverified.test is not on your allowlist. No approval path exists for this rule — edit the mandate (which re-signs it) to add the payee. (reason code R_BLOCK_PAYEE). The engine evaluated it against signed mandate v4 and refused before any PayPal call was made.

steps.label: Counterfactual
steps.detail: Adding newvendor@unverified.test to your allowlist (which re-signs the mandate as a new version) would have allowed this action.
